title: When two dispatchers reorder the same technician, the later drop wins
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. A second dispatcher with Work Orders create and edit at the same location, signed in in a second browser (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two").
  5. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  6. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  7. Work orders (Approved), lead Ana: "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Charlie Co". Nobody has reordered Ana's work, so both browsers show Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co.
custom_steps:
1. In both browsers open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST" and click Board View.
  2. In browser 1, drag Charlie Co to the top of Ana's column and release.
  3. In browser 2, without refreshing, drag Bravo Co to the top of Ana's column and release.
  4. In browser 1, watch the screen for a warning, then refresh.
  5. In browser 2, refresh.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: browser 1 shows no warning about the other change.
  • After browser 1 refreshes, Ana's column shows browser 2's saved order: Bravo Co, Alpha Co, Charlie Co (the later save wins).
  • Step 5: browser 2 shows the same order, Bravo Co, Alpha Co, Charlie Co.
  • If either browser shows "The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again." or "The board is busy with another move. Please try again.", the card goes back to where it was. Write it down; that is a different, allowed outcome checked in the Story 4 cases.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R11, S4-N11, S4-N12, read 8 Oct 2026. Concurrency decision: Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-35 (Chris Ward, 28 Sep 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R11: “Save the manual order of work orders once per location. Everyone at the location sees the same order, in both Tech View and Board View. If two people reorder at the same time, the later save wins; the other person sees the saved order on their next refresh and is not warned.”
  • S4-N11: “A card dropped next to a work order that someone else has just moved is not saved. The alert reads “The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again.” and the card goes back to where it was.”
  • S4-N12: “When two people drop into the same technician at the same moment and the second cannot be saved in time, the alert reads “The board is busy with another move. Please try again.” and the card goes back to where it was.”
